descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Pass The Dutchie is a social VR hangout for groups, clans and competitive teams. Kick back with your crew in a 90s basement, then head down to the bunker to plan your next comp match together.

HANG OUT
- Up to 20 players in a room, with voice chat that stays in the room you're in
- Join the public basement or make your own server: public, or private with a 4-digit join code for your group only
- Two card tables with a full deck, chips, an UNO-style deck and a dealer screen with 25 games and their rules
- A bar with four beer taps, real pouring, bottles and shots
- Darts with a 301 scoreboard, foam dart blasters and a boombox with radio stations
- A tube TV with a retro console, four controllers and parody racing, pod racing and shooter games
- A movie projector with public-domain and open films

PLAN YOUR MATCHES
- A code-locked strategy bunker with armoured doors and 20 seats, with its own voice chat away from the party upstairs
- Map layouts on the projector screen, a laser pointer and a neon pen to draw routes and calls
- A chalkboard that keeps your plans saved for next time, and a host who controls the door code

Comfort: snap or smooth turning, comfort options, block and report tools.

Mature content: depicts cannabis and alcohol use, crude humour, cartoon violence and gore.

Radio music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0).
